incident-bot: PAGER: HIGH error-rate and routing failures observed for smartroute -> APAC. 5xx spike (gateway/model-mismatch) from 1978003000-1978003300, customer error% ~9%. Alert: smartroute.policy.apac deviation. Paging @Priya oncall.
Priya (Oncall): acked. Investigating. Where are the errors originating (edge vs origin)?
Alex (SRE): I'm seeing repeated 502s from the inference gateway in ap-southeast-1. Logs show requests forwarded to model-variant:v2 instead of v1 for a subset of IPs. Example:
```
[1978003151] request_id=3f2a... client_ip=13.54.x.x route=apac-primary target=model-v2 status=502 "model-compatibility-error"
```
Marta (Eng Platform): smartroute policy for APAC was changed yesterday to allow regional fallback to pooled-capacity (model-v2) when local v1 is overloaded. Could be policy mis-eval.
Raj (Network): DNS traces look weird. Some edge participants still resolving to old edge-nodes (edge-rrset setA) while origin mapping expects edge setB. dig to one failing client shows TTL=300 but authoritative changed to 60 earlier; looks like stale answers in our CDN layer.
Taryn (Support): Customer reports: "inference failing intermittently in APAC, some requests fail fast" — several big customers affected, surface impact: short-tail inference for production features.
Priya (Oncall): Hypothesis: stale edge RR-set at some PoPs causing requests to land on nodes with a different routing config (older model pin), smartroute sees incompatible model and returns errors. We should test isolating edge sets and disable region fallback temporarily.
Alex (SRE): Running quick check: curl -H 'X-Region: ap-southeast-1' https://smartroute.redwood/api/health -> 200 from most, but 502 from IP range 13.54.x. That IP range corresponds to edge setA.
Marta (Eng Platform): Action 1: applying a temporary override to smartroute.policy.apac -> force_prefer_local = true (no fallback to pooled v2). Applying now.
```
configctl set smartroute.policy.apac.force_prefer_local true --source=oncall-1978003333
```
Priya (Oncall): done. Pushing a canary rollout to 10% of APAC first.
incident-bot: Deploy started: rollout-id=rl-197800-1 -> 10% -> initiated by Priya
Alex (SRE): Monitoring error rate after override... sending metrics.
(5m)
Alex (SRE): Error-rate dropped from 9% -> 2.1% within the canary window. Good sign. Some residual failures remain from edge setA.
Raj (Network): I requested CDN edge cache purge for the affected zone (edge-rrset setA). Purge in progress; provider ETA ~2-3 minutes.
Taryn (Support): Notified first-line CS for affected accounts with template: "We're aware of APAC inference interruptions; mitigation in progress. ETA updates in 30m." Will update customers if we have more info.
Priya (Oncall): While purge happens, let's avoid config churn. Do we need to roll back yesterday's policy change? Marta?
Marta (Eng Platform): I recommend we revert the policy change that allowed pooled fallback until we can validate DNS propagation behavior. Reverting now.
```
configctl rollback smartroute.policy.apac --to=2026-03-12T22:10:00Z --reason="incidental edge drift causing mismatches"
```
incident-bot: Rollback applied by Marta. Verifying.
(3m)
Alex (SRE): Rollback verification: all requests now show target=model-v1 in APAC. Error rate down to 0.8% overall. Looks like policy rollback + edge purge fixed majority.
Raj (Network): CDN reported purge succeeded. They also noted edge BGPs were still advertising old RRset in some PoPs due to upstream cache. I'm opening ticket with CDN provider to investigate propagation path.
Taryn (Support): Customers notified of partial mitigation: "We rolled back a routing change and purged edge caches; we see error rates decreasing. We'll continue monitoring and follow up with root cause." Sent to affected list.
Priya (Oncall): Good. I'll keep monitoring for 30min. Who will take long-form RCA and postmortem? Marta/Network?
Marta (Eng Platform): I'll lead the runbook/RCAs for the smartroute policy part. Raj, can you own network/DNS propagation analysis and timeline?
Raj (Network): Yep. I'll collect dig traces, bgp views, CDN logs, and timeline. Opening ticket DN-197800 with provider and cc'ing infra.
Alex (SRE): Suggest we add a safety guard: if smartroute observes >X% divergence in resolved edge rrsets vs expected (based on our authoritative), block automatic fallback to pooled models and page ops. I'll open a PR to smartroute-safety.
Priya (Oncall): Handoff in 45m to next oncall. Summary for next oncall (copy to channel):
- Incident: APAC smartroute 5xx spike due to stale edge RRset + policy fallback opened to pooled model variants causing model-compatibility 502s.
- Actions taken: forced prefer_local override; applied rollback of yesterday's policy change; purged CDN edge cache; notified customers; opened tickets with CDN provider.
- Current state: error rate ~0.5%-1% and trending down. No active mitigations required but monitoring.
- Owners: Marta (policy RCA), Raj (DNS/CDN RCA), Alex (SRE follow-ups + safety PR), Taryn (customer comms)
Priya (Oncall): Handoff -> @Alex will monitor metrics dashboard for 2 hours; @Marta/Raj to produce RCA within 48h. I'll create incident doc and assign postmortem.
Alex (SRE): Adding an actionable: update the deployment checklist so that policy rollouts require edge RRset quiescence (CDN TTL stable) for 30m before enabling pooled fallback. Will draft change.
Marta (Eng Platform): Also adding: temp feature flag to disable pooled-fallback on region if DNS propagation variance > threshold. Will spec.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied at 1978003420. Customer impact reduced. Created incident ticket INC-197800-APAC-smartroute.
Taryn (Support): I'll follow up with customers once RCA draft is available. Keeping them updated.
Raj (Network): CDN provider responded: they saw a target-origin sync job fail at 1978002900 causing inconsistent edge RRsets for ~12 minutes. They will provide logs in ticket.
Priya (Oncall): Thanks team. I'll close the immediate paging loop. Next steps are RCA and safeguards. If anyone sees a regression, re-page / escalate.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (partial): status=stable -> monitoring. Close to oncall handoff at 1978007200.
